title: Workflow time, capacity, productivity, and benefit realization
purpose: Translates gross task-time savings into net time, usable capacity, realized output, quality-adjusted productivity, and economic value.
input: `Tasks` sheet with task, baseline minutes, AI minutes, review minutes, correction minutes, annual volume, redeployable fraction, quality factor, and staff cost per hour; `Parameters` sheet with capacity utilization assumption.
outputs: Gross and net time savings, released and used capacity, labor-value estimate, quality-adjusted productivity, task comparison chart, and common-error flags.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
